**sdd/issue-239-a3/apply-progress**

**What**: Phase 1 (PR-1, merged into feature/v2.0.0) — tasks 1.1-1.14 — `labelEvents` verb + `m3` close + actor-check/brain-writes-reviewed CLI-hardcoding fixes + `prReviews` verb + regression guard. DONE (see prior revision for full detail; final state 1169/1169 tests, 395/400 non-test diff).

Phase 2 (PR-2, this run, branch feat/issue-239-a3-pr2, based on updated feature/v2.0.0=35d4ab0) — tasks 2.1-2.6 — GitLab `prView`/`mrCreate` un-stub over `gitlabApiFetch`. DONE, all 6 tasks [x].

**Why**: Phase 2 replaces the GitLab `prView`/`mrCreate` graceful-degrade stubs with real direct-API-v4 implementations, matching the GitHub contract exactly, so GitLab repos get real MR metadata/creation instead of always-empty/always-failing results.

**Where** (Phase 2 files):
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs` — `prView` un-stubbed: `GET /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid` via `gitlabApiFetch`, normalizes `iid`/`description`/`author.username` → `number`/`body`/`author`; try/catch returns `{ number, labels: null, body: null, author: null }` on failure (uncomputable), never throws. `mrCreate` un-stubbed: `POST /projects/:id/merge_requests` via `gitlabApiFetch` with `{ source_branch, target_branch, title, description, labels }` payload (labels joined comma-separated, omitted key entirely when empty array); returns `{ url: r.web_url }` on success, `{ url: null, error: err.message }` on failure. Both thread `{ apiBase, token, proxyUrl, fetchImpl }` as params with LOCAL defaults (public gitlab.com API base, `vcsToken()`, no proxy) — same discipline as `issueView`/`labelEvents`/`prReviews`; NO direct pipeline-env read (GATE_FILE, drift-guard stays green).
- `brain/scripts/vcs/gitlab-api.mjs` — `gitlabApiFetch` extended with optional `method` (defaults `'GET'`, backward-compatible) and `body` (JSON-serialized + `Content-Type: application/json` header when present) so `mrCreate`'s POST reuses the SAME shared transport — never a second hand-rolled fetch.
- `brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md` — Phase-3 status table rows flipped: GitLab `prView`/`mrCreate` "stub — not yet implemented" → "implemented (A3 — issue #239)". L6 `brain-writes-reviewed` gate engaged (6th slice touching brain/core/, expected PASS+warn, established path).
- Tests: `brain/scripts/vcs/gitlab-api.test.mjs` (+2 RED→GREEN: POST body/Content-Type, GET-default backward-compat), `brain/scripts/vcs/providers.test.mjs` (stub tests for `gitlab.prView`/`gitlab.mrCreate` REPLACED with 9 new RED→GREEN tests: normalized success shape, null-fields-on-failure, author-defaults-null, apiBase-default, CLI-free proof, POST payload shape, labels-omitted-when-empty, base-defaults-main, error-on-failure).
- `openspec/changes/issue-239-a3/tasks.md` — tasks 2.1-2.6 marked [x], with 2.4 (i18n) recorded as N/A (no `i18n/t.mjs` importer in these files, only new string surface is `err.message` propagated from the existing `gitlabApiFetch` thrown error, no new CLI-facing string).

**Learned**: `gitlabApiConfig()`/CI consumers (`ci-context.mjs`'s `defaultFetchMr`) call `gitlabApiFetch` directly for MR context and were NOT touched — that's a separate, already-implemented consumer (REQ-CIC-5), out of Phase-2 scope. The "Required verbs" table in `vcs-contract.md` (lines 22-34) still doesn't have `prView`/`mrCreate` rows (only the separate "Phase 3 adapter status" table does) — task 2.5 explicitly scoped only the status-table flip, so left as-is; no PLAN-DEVIATION, matches task text exactly.

Final Phase-2 state: 1178/1178 tests pass (was 1169 after PR-1; +9 new). `npm run brain:repo:check` and `npm run brain:nav` both green. Non-test counted diff: 116/400 lines (vcs-contract.md +2/-2, gitlab-api.mjs +15/-2, gitlab.mjs +84/-11). All 6 Phase-2 tasks marked [x]. Phase 3 (shared parameterized contract suite + recorded-from-real fixtures, PR-3) NOT started — remains for the next apply batch.
